anacorp-ana-corp:lever:aede3924-9c1e-4ff.title: Plant Supervisor
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:aede3924-9c1e-4ff.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, with locations in Cypress, California, and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling, and we are seeking a Plant Supervisor to join our growing team in an onsite position in Henderson, Nevada. As a Plant Supervisor, you will oversee and manage production shift employees and ensure compliance with safety, quality, and quantity standards. We are committed to delivering high-quality products while maintaining operational excellence. We are currently seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Plant Supervisor to join our team and oversee daily operations at our manufacturing facility. As a Plant Supervisor, you will be responsible for coordinating and supervising the activities of the plant floor, ensuring efficient production, adherence to quality standards, and a safe working environment. You will work closely with a team of operators and technicians to achieve production goals and maintain operational efficiency. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership skills, excellent problem-solving abilities, and a solid understanding of manufacturing processes. This position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 7:00 am – 4:00 pm. Must be able to open the shop daily by 6:45 am and stay until the plant is closed. This role reports to the Plant Manager.
responsibilities: Team Leadership and Development : Provide leadership and guidance to the plant floor team, ensuring clear communication, goal alignment, and a positive work environment. Supervise and schedule plant personnel, ensuring adequate staffing levels to meet production requirements. Train, mentor, and motivate employees, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and personal development.

Production Coordination:  Monitor production schedules and coordinate production activities to ensure on-time delivery of products. Collaborate with production planning and supply chain teams to optimize resource utilization and minimize downtime. Address production issues, troubleshoot problems, and implement corrective actions to ensure efficient operations. Must be prepared to pivot on a regular cadence to schedule changes.

Quality Control and Assurance:  Enforce and maintain quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with quality standards and specifications. Conduct regular inspections of production processes and finished products to identify and address quality concerns. Collaborate with the quality control team to implement process improvements and enhance product quality. Must drive the daily quality requirements and ensure that the culture drives full compliance.

Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance:  Promote and enforce adherence to health, safety, and environmental regulations and guidelines. Conduct safety inspections, identify potential hazards, and implement preventive measures. Investigate incidents and accidents, document findings, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrences.

Process Improvement:  Identify opportunities for process optimization, waste reduction, and cost savings. Analyze production data, identify trends, and implement improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and productivity. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement lean manufacturing principles and best practices.

Reporting and Documentation:  Maintain accurate production records, including production reports, inventory levels, and equipment maintenance logs. Prepare and present regular reports on production performance, key metrics, and improvement initiatives to management. Meets with Plant Manager at start of day to develop daily schedule, then at end of day to provide updates to the production schedule.

Timesheet Management & Approvals: Review, verify, and approve employee timesheets in a timely and accurate manner, ensuring compliance with company policies, payroll schedules, and applicable labor regulations. Resolve discrepancies and coordinate with payroll as needed.

Performance Documentation & Support: Maintain ongoing documentation related to employee skills, performance trends, and compliance to support annual performance reviews and management decision-making.
Other duties as assigned
qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent. Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
2+ years of experience required in a supervisory or leadership role within production and assembly in a manufacturing environment

Familiarity with quality control procedures and standards

Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines

Strong organizational skills including the use of 5S methodology

Must be able to lift 25 pounds at a time

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:bd4.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Causal & Decision Systems
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:bd4.description: CSC Generation is building closed-loop decision systems that use machine learning to operate consumer businesses more intelligently. We are starting with pricing and expanding into areas such as inventory, purchasing, promotions, marketing, and assortment. The Role You will help build systems that: estimate causal response + quantify uncertainty → choose actions → generate useful information → observe outcomes → update policies → evaluate challengers → deploy within guardrails We want to answer questions such as: What happens because we change a price, rather than simply what happens next? How should uncertainty affect a decision? When should the system exploit what it knows versus experiment to learn? Can we estimate the value of a challenger policy before fully deploying it? How do we optimize economic outcomes while respecting inventory, margin, vendor, customer, and operational constraints? What You’ll Work On Depending on your background, you may work across: causal and heterogeneous treatment-effect modeling; uncertainty estimation and calibration; contextual bandits, active learning, or sequential decision-making; policy learning and constrained optimization; counterfactual and off-policy evaluation; experimentation and champion/challenger systems; production ML infrastructure, monitoring, and automated deployment. We care about selecting the right method, not using a particular framework. What Success Looks Like Success is not a better offline metric. The systems you build should produce measurable economic lift in controlled experiments, generalize across businesses, learn from their own interventions, and safely automate an increasing share of real commercial decisions. Over time, the goal is simple: the system should become better at operating the business because it has operated the business. What We’re Looking For We care more about exceptional technical ability and judgment than matching a checklist. Strong candidates will have experience in several of: machine learning and statistical modeling; causal inference and experimentation; recommendation, advertising, pricing, marketplace, credit, or other decision systems; bandits, reinforcement learning, optimization, or active learning; uncertainty estimation; counterfactual evaluation; production ML systems; Python, SQL, and large behavioral datasets. Why This Role Is Different Most ML systems learn from a dataset. Here, the decisions made by the model influence the data the model sees next. That creates a continuous loop: Decision → intervention → outcome → learning → better decision The long-term opportunity is to build that capability once and apply it across a portfolio of businesses and increasingly broad commercial decisions. Application Requirement Due to a high volume of fraudulent applications, you must share a valid LinkedIn profile URL in the application questions below to be considered. If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:06cae632-5345-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Engineer – API Integrationen, Connectoren, Worker/Jobs, Mailer Service, QA based in France. This role is an opportunity to build robust backend systems and integrations that connect critical business platforms and services. You’ll work across APIs, connectors, background jobs, messaging, email delivery, persistence, and quality assurance. The position requires an engineering mindset focused on reliability, traceability, and handling real-world failure scenarios rather than relying on happy-path implementations. You’ll design integrations that remain resilient through rate limits, webhooks, timeouts, retries, and other operational challenges. Working on a project basis, you’ll have significant ownership over technical deliverables and architecture decisions. This is a strong fit for a backend engineer who enjoys solving complex integration problems and building dependable production systems. Build and maintain production-ready API integrations and connectors, prioritizing Box and HubSpot, followed by Microsoft Graph, Asana, and billing-related systems. Implement reliable authentication and integration patterns using OAuth, webhooks, pagination, rate limits, retries, and robust error handling. Design and develop queue-driven, stateful, and replayable workers and background jobs. Build and maintain a mailer service supporting PDF attachments, structured logging, retry mechanisms, delivery checks, and deduplication/idempotency. Design database schemas and implement clean, reliable migrations using PostgreSQL or comparable technologies. Implement audit events and persistent traceability mechanisms, including correlation IDs and observability across distributed processes. Develop comprehensive QA coverage, including contract tests, integration tests, and end-to-end regression testing for critical workflows such as document delivery and deadline-related processes. Use Docker, queue/eventing technologies, and observability practices to support reliable deployment and operation of backend services. Proactively identify failure modes and strengthen systems against timeouts, webhook failures, rate limiting, retries, duplicate events, and other production scenarios. Requirements Strong professional track record in backend engineering, with proficiency in Python, Node.js, Go, or a comparable backend technology. Proven experience building and maintaining production API integrations, including OAuth, webhooks, pagination, rate limits, authentication, and error handling. Solid understanding of relational databases, schema design, data persistence, and safe database migrations. Strong testing mindset with experience implementing contract, integration, unit, and/or end-to-end tests. Experience developing asynchronous, queue-based, or event-driven systems and background workers. Understanding of reliability engineering principles, including idempotency, retries, replayability, deduplication, observability, and failure-mode analysis. Experience working with Docker and modern backend development and deployment workflows. Familiarity with PostgreSQL, queue/eventing systems, and application monitoring or observability tools. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to design systems that remain reliable outside of ideal or “happy path” scenarios. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical deliverables, and communicate clearly in a remote project environment. Availability to work remotely, ideally aligned with Central European Time (CET) or European working hours. Freelance or project-based experience is suitable for this engagement. Benefits 100% remote working arrangement. Flexible project-based engagement with workload agreed upon according to availability and project needs. Full-time or part-time engagement options. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1cb03192-344d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer based in United Kingdom. This role is an opportunity to shape intuitive, accessible, and high-quality digital experiences for complex enterprise applications. You will combine strong front-end engineering expertise with a deep understanding of UI/UX and accessibility principles. Working primarily within an ASP.NET MVC 5 environment, you will translate business and user needs into polished, maintainable interfaces. Your work will help ensure applications are usable, inclusive, responsive, and compliant with modern accessibility standards. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, customers, designers, QA specialists, and technology teams. The position offers a hands-on engineering environment where you can influence both technical implementation and the overall user experience. You will also contribute to technical specifications, testing, documentation, and the delivery of reliable production-ready solutions. Design, develop, enhance, and maintain accessible, user-centered interfaces for complex enterprise applications built on ASP.NET MVC 5. Translate business requirements, user needs, and design concepts into clean, intuitive, maintainable, and production-ready front-end experiences. Apply UI/UX principles including information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and responsive design to real-world applications. Apply semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and other accessibility best practices. Test interfaces using assistive technologies and screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver, as appropriate. Develop and support full-stack .NET applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, SQL Server, and related Microsoft technologies in a Windows environment. Build and integrate front-end experiences with RESTful APIs and internal or external systems. Work with Microsoft SQL Server, including data models, T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and views required to support application functionality. Prepare technical design specifications, technical documentation, and clear design documentation. Write and maintain unit tests while supporting QA, usability testing, accessibility validation, and release activities. Analyze requirements, troubleshoot complex UI and cross-browser issues, and deliver stable, polished solutions within established timelines. Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, designers, and cross-functional technology teams to validate solutions and resolve issues. Contribute to design reviews, accessibility audits, usability initiatives, and continuous improvements to the application's user experience. Work independently within established enterprise codebases while identifying opportunities to modernize and improve legacy front-end components. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5–8+ years of professional software development experience, with significant hands-on experience in front-end and UI development. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery, with a focus on clean, semantic, maintainable markup. Demonstrated ability to apply UI/UX principles such as information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design. Hands-on experience implementing and testing accessible web experiences against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards. Practical knowledge of ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessibility testing with assistive technologies. Strong proficiency in C# and ASP.NET MVC 5, with experience developing and supporting full-stack .NET applications in Win

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5fbee04c-71c7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in Netherlands. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role. Investigate changes in product, marketing, and business KPIs, identify root causes, and translate findings into clear business recommendations. Conduct user behavior, funnel, retention, cohort, and segmentation analyses to understand product performance and customer behavior. Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments, including A/B tests, CUPED/CUPAC methodologies, and the use of proxy metrics. Quantify the expected and actual impact of product and marketing initiatives and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, and other business teams to support data-driven decision-making and influence roadmap priorities. Generate actionable insights that help improve product performance, customer engagement, retention, and business outcomes. Work with Data Engineering to define analytical requirements, improve data quality, and strengthen the reliability of analytical datasets. Contribute to analytics infrastructure, dashboards, reporting processes, and metric systems to make insights more accessible and consistent. Help establish analytical standards, best practices, and reliable definitions for key product and marketing metrics. Support marketing and growth analytics, including LTV, CAC, attribution, funnel measurement, performance analysis, and optimization. Develop and validate leading indicators and proxy metrics that enable faster and more informed business decisions. Gradually take ownership of larger cross-functional analytical projects and drive them independently from definition through delivery. Mentor and support junior analysts, sharing analytical expertise and helping strengthen team capabilities. Participate in analytical planning and prioritization while developing stronger stakeholder management and communication skills with senior business leaders. Progressively take responsibility for analytical processes, quality standards, and team performance as preparation for a Product Analytics Team Lead position. Requirements Strong professional experience in Product Analytics, with a track record of using data to influence product and business decisions. Advanced SQL and strong data analysis capabilities. Hands-on experience with product metrics, funnels, retention, cohort analysis, experimentation, and growth analytics. Strong business and product thinking, with the ability to connect analytical findings to commercial and strategic outcomes. Ability to translate complex datasets and analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:82755bf.title: Head of Operations
southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:82755bf.description: About Centari At Centari, we're transforming the world's contracts into actionable intelligence. Every firm has the same AI now. What separates them is institutional intelligence: how the firm has structured deals, priced risk, and navigated markets across every transaction it has closed. It's why a client picks one law firm over another, and why an LP backs one fund over the next. Today, this knowledge sits buried in closed deals and in the heads of the people who worked on them. Centari brings it to the surface as structured data that AI can act on, empowering companies to generate new revenue and see opportunities no one else can. The most demanding transactional practices in the world already build on Centari, including deal teams at Ropes & Gray, DLA Piper, Willkie, Fried Frank, and Wilson Sonsini. We proved it in law. Finance and the enterprise face the same problem at greater scale, and we're going after all of it. We raised an oversubscribed Series A from investors including Sentinel Global, GTMfund, South Park Commons, Jack Altman, RiverPark Capital, and Recall Capital, and now we're building the team to match our ambition. For more information, check out centari.com http://centari.com or find us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/centariapp/. The Role We're hiring our first Head of Operations to build the operational foundation Centari runs on. Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own planning, financial strategy, and the day-to-day operations that power a growing company. This is a rare early-stage role with real leadership potential: the funding and momentum of a company at an inflection point, with room for a standout operator to grow into a much larger role as we scale. What You'll Do - Run our planning cadence. Set the framework for measuring success quarterly and weekly, track our goals and metrics, and make progress visible so everyone knows our priorities and how we're tracking against them. - Own the financial model. Manage the budget, track burn and runway, build scenarios, and give the CEO and board clear answers on how decisions affect the numbers. - Handle core operations. Payroll, benefits, insurance, vendors, and customer invoicing. You'll start by running these yourself while scoping and implementing the resources to scale these tasks efficiently. - Support the CEO on the highest-priority work. Board decks, investor updates, and the analysis behind major decisions. - Take on more over time. As you build a track record, this role can grow into wider commercial and strategic responsibilities. What You Bring - At least 7 years of experience across investment banking, private equity, consulting, or startup operations. The strongest candidates pair a top-tier finance or consulting background with hands-on experience at an early-stage startup, but we'll seriously consider exceptional candidates who bring one or the other. - Strong financial modeling skills. You're comfortable building and owning a company budget and forecast. - Excellent writing. You hold a high bar for how a company communicates, and you can be trusted with work that goes to the board, investors, and the market. - A bias for action and no ego about the work. At the start, you'll be building systems for scale and running payroll in the same week. - Interest in growing into a larger leadership role as the company scales. What We Offer - Competitive salary and meaningful equity - Comprehensive health coverage (Centari covers 100% of employee premiums) - Dental and vision (Centari covers 75% of employee premiums) - 401(k) with employer match up to 4% - Lunch covered for in-office team - Flexible PTO

southparkcommons-sparrow:ashbyhq:c7ad76e.title: Leave Specialist
southparkcommons-sparrow:ashbyhq:c7ad76e.description: ABOUT US Sparrow is the first high-tech, high-touch employee leave management solution. Our mission is to make it simple for companies to provide their employees with all kinds of leave (i.e. family, medical, etc.). Currently, the leave management process is painful and inefficient for everyone. Company leaders struggle to keep up with regulations and processes that change frequently, and the employees going on leave are overwhelmed by bureaucracy at an exceptionally important juncture in their career. Sparrow transforms this ordinarily tedious, error-prone, complex to remain compliant, and time-consuming process into a 30-minute end-to-end experience saving teams time (20 - 40 hours per leave) and money (up to $30K per leave). Sparrow is headquartered in San Francisco but all employees work remotely across the country. Sparrow is a diverse, highly talented, and supportive team. Together, we are hardworking, collaborative, smart, and humble—after all, we’re solving real problems. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Leave Specialist, you will be the primary contact for employees of companies we service and will manage a leave of absence from start to finish. southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:02e29751-f.description: ABOUT TOWN We're an applied AI company building a powerful assistant that makes it easy for anyone to create and use software in their everyday work. Town starts from who you are. It builds a persistent model of you — your voice, judgment, relationships, priorities — and does real work on your behalf across every tool you use: email, calendar, docs, Slack, CRM. It doesn't wait to be prompted. It observes, learns, and acts. The more you use it, the more it becomes an extension of you. We most recently raised a $55M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, Alt Capital, and Conviction. We work in person in San Francisco's Financial District, five days a week. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a founding iOS engineer to own the Town iOS app end-to-end and make the assistant feel native, fast, and trustworthy on Apple platforms. You'll build the surfaces where people hand Town their work and watch it act on their behalf. This is a small team, so you'll really own it all end to end: architecture, performance, and polish. Most "AI on iOS" today is a webview wrapper around a chat box. That isn't the bar. The bar is: a user picks up their iPhone, Town does the thing they actually wanted, and it feels like Apple shipped it themselves. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the Town iOS app end-to-end — architecture, performance, and the details that make it feel native. - Build and ship new mobile experiences that let users intuitively and easily hand Town real work and see it done. - Raise the bar on reliability, latency, and responsiveness across the app. - Work closely with product, design, and backend to turn ambitious ideas into shipped features. YOU MIGHT THRIVE HERE IF YOU... - Have experience building high-quality iOS applications in production. Maybe you've even built consumer apps at scale, or taken one from 0-1. - Know the Apple ecosystem cold — Xcode, SwiftUI, UIKit, and Swift concurrency. - Have owned a complex, business-critical iOS app end-to-end and made real architectural tradeoffs. - Care deeply about performance, security, and user experience — you can tell within seconds whether an app was built by people who care. - Have strong opinions about how a native app should behave and read the Apple Human Interface Guidelines for fun. - Move fast, decide at 70%, and run through walls to find the work. LOCATION In-person in San Francisco's Financial District (right near Montgomery BART), five days a week.
